software_inspections.observation: Base parameters frozen; only rotation parameters passed to SGDG with stiefel=True.
Cayley-style Stiefel optimizer implemented; not a new optimizer supplied by CATS-NPU.
Random/structured rotations and paired query/key transforms in existing implementation.
Inspected implementation uses softmax teacher/student cross-entropy; alternative margin/RankNet discussion verified from paper, not assumed present here.

candidate: Frozen-encoder orthogonal calibration with pairwise rank/margin distillation.
falsified_distinction: Optimizing correlated pairwise score errors supplies a capability beyond ordinary rank-aware rotation; the objective is the same pairwise margin discrepancy.
alternative_checked: Reciprocal dyadic scaling: no change to normal-range quantized coordinate products under explicit binary-rounding assumptions.
hardware_scoring_evidence: Not collected; novelty stopping rule applied before method/scoring development.
